mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate below 2.0% (current level) consistently predicts positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns, as low interest rates reduce the discount rate for equity valuations and increase risk appetite.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL reading above 3.0% (annualized) signals persistent inflation, leading to monetary tightening expectations that reduce equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.0.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising FEDFUNDS and rising CPIAUCSL (indicating tightening monetary policy amid persistent inflation) predicts negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns, as dual pressure increases risk aversion and reduces equity multiples.
failure_condition: The interaction of FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL shows a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the negative return prediction holds in less than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 3.5%), labor market tightness increases wage pressures and corporate profit margins, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE < 3.5.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 105.0 (current level) consistently predicts positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns, as strong manufacturing activity signals robust economic growth and corporate earnings expansion.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances where INDPRO > 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts (HOUST) level above 1300.0 (current level) signals strong consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances where HOUST > 1300.0.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising industrial production (INDPRO) and rising housing starts (HOUST) (indicating strong supply and demand in the economy) predicts positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns, as dual strength supports corporate earnings and reduces recession risk.
failure_condition: The interaction of INDPRO and HOUST shows a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the positive return prediction holds in less than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a strong supply growth regime (INDPRO > 105.0 and rising for 3 months), the S&P 500 produces positive forward 20-day returns, as robust industrial output supports corporate earnings and economic confidence.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances where INDPRO > 105.0 and rising for 3 months.
